about.title: About us
about.description: Who we are and how we offer damaged vehicles.
about.intro: {company} offers vehicles with accident, engine, gearbox, electrical or flood damage – for workshops, hobbyists, traders and private buyers who want to assess the condition themselves.
about.p1: Every vehicle is photographed and the known damage is described as precisely as possible. We distinguish between verified information and information from third parties.
about.p2: We do not sell online: you inspect the vehicle at our premises, and all formalities are handled on site.

visit.title: Visiting on site
visit.description: How to inspect a vehicle at our premises: process, access, parking and opening hours.
visit.intro: You can inspect every vehicle in person. Please follow the process below.
visit.step1: Choose a vehicle online and note its reference.
visit.step2: Call us to book a viewing appointment (recommended).
visit.step3: Check the vehicle and the described damage yourself on site – feel free to bring a companion or an expert.
visit.step4: The purchase and all formalities take place on site only.
visit.safetyText: Damaged vehicles can have sharp edges, leaking fluids or damaged high-voltage systems. Please follow the instructions of our staff. Vehicles that are not drivable cannot be test-driven.
visit.bring2: Optional: an OBD diagnostic tool or an expert
visit.bring3: For collection: transport (trailer / towing service) for vehicles that are not drivable

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: Information on the processing of personal data.
privacy.draftNotice: Template text for the demo version. Have it reviewed legally and adapt it to the actual processing before going live.
privacy.controllerText: The controller for data processing on this website is {company}, {address}, email: {email}.
privacy.hostingText: The website is hosted by Netlify; database and photos by Supabase. When you visit, technically necessary data (e.g. IP address, time, page requested) is processed to provide the website securely (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). Data processing agreements are or must be concluded with these providers.
privacy.cookiesText: We only use technically necessary cookies: one cookie stores your chosen language. There are no tracking or advertising cookies. Visitors do not need an account.
privacy.contactText: If you write to us using the form, we process your details to answer your enquiry (Art. 6(1)(b) or (f) GDPR). Messages are deleted after 12 months at the latest unless statutory retention obligations apply.
privacy.mapText: The map (OpenStreetMap) is only loaded after you click. Your IP address is then transmitted to the map provider.
privacy.rightsText: You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection, as well as the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority.

legal.title: Legal notice
legal.draftNotice: Demo details. Replace them with the real company details and have them reviewed legally before going live.
legal.providerTitle: Information pursuant to § 5 DDG (German Digital Services Act)
legal.disputeText: We are neither willing nor obliged to take part in dispute resolution proceedings before a consumer arbitration board.
legal.liabilityText: Vehicle descriptions are non-binding and do not replace an inspection. Errors and prior sale excepted.
